topics.title: Teenage Murder and Strange Incidents
topics.summary: A seventeen-year-old boy is accused of killing a man ten years prior who had molested him; the case becomes complicated by claims he was the victim, leading to legal challenges. Simultaneously, a West Orange teacher is arrested for cocaine possession, followed by an Oklahoma teenager giving birth unexpectedly and a bizarre incident involving a utility tower and a burned man attempting a bet.

topics.title: Radio Host Improvises & Diamond Sales
topics.summary: A radio host engages in a lengthy, meandering conversation about his late nights, improvising for four hours while discussing Batman, loose diamonds, and a bizarre contest to guess the side of a testicle. He briefly addresses listener complaints before promoting diamond sales with an unusual offer.

topics.title: Critics Critique Movie Reviews
topics.summary: Two individuals express frustration with film critics who offer overly harsh reviews without understanding a movie’s intentions or audience appeal, dismissing them as stemming from exclusive circles lacking an obvious perspective. One critic highlights their perceived standards while the other dismisses their opinions entirely.

topics.title: George Max and the Stonewall Postmark
topics.summary: During a radio segment, host Robin discusses conversations with Freddie about George Maxine. They recount a brief encounter with Bruce from Car Cash followed by speculation regarding a San Francisco ‘stonewall’ postmark featuring depictions of same-sex couples frolicking – a symbol apparently issued by the government. Jesse Helms expresses outrage over this postal stamp and its implications.

topics.title: Jackie Mertling's Unhinged Confession
topics.summary: During a lengthy and incoherent phone call, Jackie Mertling recounts a past affair involving Jerry and Pat Lofford, detailing bizarre events like swimming with an erection while struggling to cope with regret and alcohol. topics.title: Radio Show Discussion of ‘Gay Squirty Dancing’ and Personal Frustrations
topics.summary: During a radio show, hosts repeatedly discuss reviewing ‘gay squirty dancing,’ describing it as the funniest thing they've ever heard while comparing it to a real reviewer. They then shift abruptly to discussing personal frustrations with former NBC program director Mark Churn, detailing his abrasive behavior and demanding nature alongside recollections of an awkward dinner with a gay couple.
